name: session-worktree-isolation
title: Isolate concurrent agent sessions via git worktrees
description: Parallel agent sessions currently run against one shared checkout, so concurrent implement/check runs write the same working tree and the same generated artifacts (manifest, plugin tree, partition, ledger) and can interleave. Evaluate giving each session its own git worktree, including what generated state can be shared and what must be per-worktree. Scope and acceptance criteria to be defined in prd.md. Filed from 08-09-thin-machine-installer.
creator: sdelmas
